Extremely delicious Vietnamese “Banh mi”
Oct 2025 • Family
The Vietnamese "banh mi" are delicious. The space is nostalgic, classic, very quiet for you to relax, listen to music or read a book. We ordered 3 Vietnamese banh mi with 3 different parts: egg sausage banh mi, grilled pork banh mi, teriyaki chicken banh mi. 3 completely different flavors and extremely delicious, the flavors highlight the main ingredients inside the banh mi as its name suggests. But if you like spicy food, you can add chili, then the banh mi will probably be more perfect. It's has good combination between cucumber, salad and main ingredient inside. 1 banh mi and 1 cup of milk coffee in the morning will help you be full of energy and alert to work. We had a very energetic and comfortable morning. Thank you to the service staff for being very attentive in advising and bringing out the food for us. We will come back next time.

Horrible experience
Feb 2025 • Solo
I got so humiliated in this place. 
I want today to have a bahn mi and a coffee, it’s a rainy day on a weekend and the place was full. I placed my order (paid) and found one available table outside where I set and waited for my order. No one said anything about me sitting there.

After about 10 minutes that I’m there, one of the girls working there came to and said that she gave a group of five people and I need to get up and give them my table. I was so confused by the requests but then she said that she is actually just moving me to a smaller table so I of course agree to change a table. The moment I got up the group of five took my place and I follow the girl to my new table, just to find out that it is taken as well if the rest of the tables in the place. Keep in mind it is raining and I’m standing in the middle of everyone while stars passing between the different tables and ask if I can join them.
I had a terrible morning (not that it matters) and I didn’t want to share a table with a stranger while I’m crying, so I told her to please make my order take away. 

As you have to pay when you order, I had no choice but to wait in this point.

I felt so uncomfortable, I cluster aside because it was raining so hard, so I just Stood like a fool in the middle between all the very crowded tables, while everyone is staring at all that awful situation.

Unfortunately it’s one of those places that once you paid them and they received the money, that’s it. 

They literally made me leave just so they can get more people.

So you got the table of 5, and yes I’m just one person, but you lost me as a costumer. (And I actually live here).
Money is not everything in life, and treating people with respect and not Humiliate them should be basic.

I left crying and will never come back to this place.
If I could give less than 1 star I would have.
